g.text: The criterion arm, which scores control trials only and so has no hit rate: ours (●, 58–91 decidable per stage) and Macar et al. (■).

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Whiskers: two-sided 95% Clopper–Pearson; k/n = affirmations / decidable trials. Hollow bar: the audit’s post-hoc reading (8 of 25 affirmations), base .29–.34.

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Hollow circle: the record’s own hand correction for the non-asserting class, SFT 0.176. Base is below its decidable floor (58 of 96 run; floor 64) and is descriptive.
